entries.title: Aggregation tests exhaust the JVM heap
entries.root_cause: The aggregation suite retains its expanded fixture beyond the configured 512 MB test heap. Increase the test heap or reduce retained fixture memory.

entries.title: Aggregation tests exceed the command deadline
entries.root_cause: The aggregation suite waits for an unbounded retry against the unavailable fixture server until the 600-second command deadline. Bound the retry or restore that service.
entries.differs_from_earlier: The same test step reaches a time limit rather than exhausting JVM heap.

entries.title: Aggregation fixture exhausts heap again
entries.root_cause: The aggregation suite retains its expanded fixture beyond the configured 512 MB test heap. Increase the test heap or reduce retained fixture memory.
entries.differs_from_earlier: A later test run fails on a different allocation path after more tests complete.

entries.title: Aggregation test heap exhausted again
entries.root_cause: The aggregation suite retains its expanded fixture beyond the configured 512 MB test heap. Increase the test heap or reduce retained fixture memory.
entries.differs_from_earlier: A later run on another image reports the same heap limit and fixture retention through another stack location.
